text:
Eve Ops: Quick heads-up: telemetry for the upcoming Launch Weekend (product-A) shows sustained 2.8-3.4x baseline for gen requests and short microbursts hitting ~14% of peak for 10-30s. We need an explicit capacity hedge and cost-amortization plan. Who can run a fast GPU-hours projection + tradeoffs for reserved vs burst capacity?

Sanjay: I can take this. Preliminary numbers below — rough, will tighten after loadtest.
- baseline tokens/hr = 1.2M -> 3x => 3.6M tokens/hr
- avg tokens/req = 120 -> reqs/hr = 30k
- throughput per A100 (p99 conservative) ~= 900k tokens/hr
- gpus_required = ceil(3.6M / 900k) = 4 -> add microburst headroom 15% => 5 GPUs
- GPU-hours/day = 5 * 24 = 120 GPU-hrs/day -> weekend (72h) = 360 GPU-hrs
- Reserved vs burst suggestion: reserve 3 GPUs, keep 2 as burst.

Noah: +1. If we can raise KV cache hit-rate to ~30% before peak we can shave ~20-25% compute. Need a small prewarm window. Also consider per-route caching TTLs for repeated prompts.

Lina: Region constraints: APAC on-prem cluster has only 2 spare A100s during that window (ops committed). We should route ~20% of prod traffic to EU as fallback to avoid failed requests. Also need to validate cross-region latency SLA impact for the product teams. Prewarm note: run cache warmers 6h prior to launch.

deploy-bot: loadtest scheduled by ops-team: starting loadgen at 2026-11-20T02:00Z for 3h, scenario = baseline*3 + 20% microbursts (10-30s). Artifacts will be uploaded to /shared/launch-weekend-loadtests.

Olga: Autoscaler tuning proposal (short-lived for launch): set maxReplicas=6, aggressive scale-up but conservative scale-down. Also disable horizontal pod evictions for 2h post-peak. Snippet: 

```
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
spec:
  maxReplicas: 6
  behavior:
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 20
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
```

Sanjay: Updated quick cost calc after accounting for reserved commit discounts:
- reserved commit (3 GPUs) = 72 GPU-hrs/day @ $2.80/hr = $201.60/day
- burst on-demand (avg 48 GPU-hrs/day) @ $3.60/hr = $172.80/day
- total/day ~= $374.40 -> 3-day weekend ~= $1,123 -> with safety fudge (~15%) plan ~$1.3k GPU cost for weekend

Eve Ops: Action items (concise):
- @Sanjay finalize GPU-hours sheet and post Google Sheet link before EOD today :link:
- @Lina draft cross-region routing policy + prewarm runbook (include fallback thresholds)
- @Olga update autoscaler manifest and push canary to staging
- @Noah prepare cache prewarm script and inject into loadtest scenario
- deploy-bot to post loadtest artifacts and timelines in this thread

Eve Ops: TL;DR: commit 3 reserved GPUs in primary region, use burst pool for microbursts, shift ~20% traffic to EU if APAC can't satisfy. Run the scheduled loadtest and reconvene after results. :thumbsup:
